svg.title: CASCADE retraction, animated
svg.desc: Animated dependency graph of the Alpha Tech LLC loan file. When the P&L statement is marked unverified, eleven nodes change level by level and the recommendation moves from Approve, pending review to Refer for review. The bank and tax branch stays untouched.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: A clean file. Every node is valid, so the preliminary call is Approve.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: An analyst flags the P&L statement as unverified.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: CASCADE retracts everything that leaned on it, level by level.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 11 nodes changed, 8 did not. The call is now Refer for review, with reasons.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Reset. Same file, same rules, same answer every time.

svg.text: Generated from the engine's own output
